lead_html: Sabye is a bright major scale. Start with the i, iv and v: play each card's lit notes, then move to the next.
history_html: D Sabye uses the seven notes of D major: D E F# G A B C#. The ding is D, and every note on the rim belongs to that one major scale. That is why the pan sounds open and happy, and why most of its chords sound settled.
Makers list it as a nine-note pan, so it is a bigger pan than the usual eight-note layouts. Different makers can lay the notes out a little differently, and this page shows one common layout.
og_description: D Sabye 9 handpan chords: the i, iv and v chord cards with the notes to play, then practice in the free chord flashcard app.
